dedupe_keys.name: scikit mobility human mobility analysis in python

description: scikit-mobility is a Python library for human mobility analysis. It represents trajectories and mobility flows with two data structures, TrajDataFrame and FlowDataFrame, and handles mobility data of various formats, including call detail records, GPS data, social media data and survey data. Coverage: generic. It extracts individual and collective metrics and patterns (length of displacements, characteristic distance, origin-destination matrices), generates synthetic individual trajectories with standard models such as random walk and exploration and preferential return, generates synthetic flows with gravity and radiation migration models, and assesses the privacy risk of a mobility dataset. Format and access: open-source library on GitHub with binder and tutorial notebooks. Licence and cost: BSD-3-Clause, free. Caveats: release cadence was not checked; network assignment is outside its scope. The library can build and synthesise origin-destination demand for network flow and agent-based transport models, for instance to rebuild demand after a disruption. It relates to Deep Gravity and MovingPandas in the catalogue.
